verdicts.one_liner: Untouched default gun carry; no patch lever moves him.

verdicts.one_liner: Untouched anti-tank; Rat King trim slightly thins the frontline pool he farms.

verdicts.indirect: No lever in this patch helps or hurts her; single-target burst into tank fronts still fails exactly as before.

verdicts.one_liner: Untouched roamer pick; no item or system shift touches her identity.

verdicts.one_liner: Small split-push QoL from the trooper fix; the economy still buries him.
verdicts.indirect: Restored wave cadence lets pushed side-lane pressure convert on schedule, a real but tiny QoL for a split pusher; the tempo economy that kills his scaling is untouched.
build_adjustments: Keep side-lane pressure on schedule — push now converts instead of stalling.

verdicts.one_liner: Untouched blind-pick bruiser; Sinclair's nerf barely touches his prey pool.
verdicts.indirect: Sinclair's broad trim weakens a matchup he already won (57-59%), a negligible effect on a hero whose value is the blind-pick frontline floor.

verdicts.one_liner: Lane-cadence fix slightly helps his all-in, but his slot keeps sliding.

build_adjustments: Play for early lane kills — wave crashes are back on schedule.
